name: Crypto Budget & Tax Keeper
tagline: A read-only budget and net-worth picture for crypto holders
description: A bookkeeper that only ever reads. It draws on bank and exchange data to assemble a plain-language budget and a net-worth picture, and keeps the crypto records organized enough to hand straight to a tax professional. No wallet connections, no orders, no moving funds , the read-only posture is the design.
author: allthemoney
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
